# HolyCrab Agent Tools v0.7.3

Model-aware asset queries and waits now keep the selected model in follow-up commands, including timeout recovery. Assets being deleted are reported as unavailable. For non-Seedance models, missing media URLs no longer produce a ready-to-generate instruction. Queries without a model retain their existing behavior.

The 22-model catalog and generation interfaces remain compatible. Seedance continues to require asset review; non-Seedance assets with usable media proceed to model-specific estimate validation. Existing final-task reuse and paid-generation confirmation are unchanged.

Installers and runtime files are verified with SHA-256. Existing configuration, installation choices, workflows and submission history are preserved. Windows retains native DPAPI credential handling. Skill content remains 1.0.2 with minimum CLI 0.7.2 because the Skill resources have not changed.

Website guides in all five languages clarify asset processing, draft/final reuse and Kling sound choices, with separate cost confirmation for drafts and finals. No Generate backend change or additional model is included in this patch.
